task_title: Stop labelling non-conflicting PRs as conflict-managed

plan_review.notes: Reviewer rejected the original pairwise-conflict-probe plan as a second conflict oracle. Decisive finding (F1): mergeCoordinationGroups seeds from every persisted state and merges seeds on any shared PR number, so a predicate-only fix would be neutralised by the existing 12-member blob. F4 correctly flagged my fail-closed probe as backwards. Design forked to retirement; subsequent verification then showed enforcement was already default-off via merged PR #2168, so scope was reduced again to draining the false labels only. F2/F3/F5/F7 concerned the probe design and are moot under the shipped change.
